objectives.text: Find the card with two red hearts that is next to a rock that is 4 tiles from a short blue house.
Find the card with two black diamonds that is beside a tall blue house that is 3 tiles from another tall blue house.
Find the card with one red square that is 7 tiles from a tall blue house that is 3 tiles from a short yellow house.
Find the card with one orange heart that is 3 tiles from a rock that is 4 tiles from a tree.
Find the card with one green square that is beside a lamppost that is beside a tall grey house.
Find the card with two orange hearts that is 2 tiles from a tall grey house that is next to a lamppost.
Find the card with two blue squares that is 2 tiles from a short yellow house that is next to a short red house.
Find the card with three red triangles that is next to a lamppost that is 3 tiles from a short yellow house.
Find the card with three orange triangles that is next to a rock that is beside a short yellow house.
Find the card with one black circle that is 4 tiles from a lamppost that is beside a short green house.
Find the card with three black squares that is next to a short red house that is beside a short yellow house.
Find the card with three green hearts that is beside a lamppost that is 3 tiles from a rock.
Find the card with three black stars that is beside a lamppost that is 3 tiles from a short yellow house.
Find the card with three red stars that is beside a short blue house that is next to a short yellow house.
Find the card with one blue star that is next to a tree that is 2 tiles from a short red house.
Find the card with one black square that is beside a short yellow house that is 3 tiles from a lamppost.
Find the card with one yellow triangle that is 3 tiles from a lamppost that is beside a short green house.
Find the card with two blue triangles that is next to a short green house that is next to a lamppost.
